reviews.title: It's good and works. Make sure you have the right setup for it.
reviews.comment: Solid Drive and a great price-to-performance ratio in today's current market. I see others have said it didn't have the speed or capacity as advertised. For the speed, make sure you have a PCIe Gen 5 port; otherwise, there is no benefit, and also a relatively capable CPU. For the capacity, storage always works like this no matter what the device is. Mainly because marketing companies say 2000GB while Windows uses GiB for capacity. It's a binary versus decimal discrepancy.  a marketing GB is 1000MB while windows counts a GiB as 1024MB. It'll always show up smaller because of this. I think Mac's use Base 10 now though so those will be the same.
reviews.author: Julian Daniels
